NYG.week10_result: Lost 24-21 to Washington on Thursday Night Football at MetLife (Nov 12, 2026), now reported 5-3-1 and still first in the NFC East. Jayden Daniels hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yd TD with 57 seconds left. J.J. McCarthy threw for a career-high 293 yds but was intercepted late, and Malik Nabers lost a red-zone fumble. S Jason Pinnock left with a back injury.

qb.notes: McCarthy is the starter because Jaxson Dart is out for the season (left knee surgery, announced in September). McCarthy took a hit to the right hip in the Week 9 win over PHI (hip pointer, Winston briefly relieved him), logged full practices and carried no designation for Week 10, where he set career highs in completions and yards (293). No new injury reported and he has 10 days rest.
